title: Insertion sort produces a sorted list
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type. For every list $\mathit{xs}$ of elements of $\alpha$, the list returned by the timed insertion sort of $\mathit{xs}$ is sorted.
hypotheses_covered: xs is a list over a linearly ordered type
replaced: For every list $\mathit{xs}$, the list returned by the timed insertion sort is sorted.
